# Low-VAF Caller Benchmark

A benchmark of somatic variant callers on cfDNA below 0.5% variant allele fraction, the range where post-operative MRD calls live. Paused since 2025-11-17 until site-level truth for the Halo truth set's contrived tier is released.

## Outcome

A benchmark of at least five callers, with and without UMI consensus, on physical dilution series with known truth below 0.5% VAF, reported as a short methods paper or a chapter of the [[mrd-review-article]].

## Current State

- **Paused.** Resume condition: the contrived-tier key of the [[halo-truth-set|Halo truth set]] is released to all sites (stage 2 of the [[halo-truth-set-blinding-and-unblinding-rules|blinding rules]]). The set shipped on 2026-05-19, but stage 2 waits until all six sites have locked results; expected after mid-November 2026. Ines's stage-1 access as WP4 statistician must not be used for this project.
- Done before pausing: a caller shortlist ([[low-vaf-caller-shortlist-2025-06]]) and in-silico dilutions of two high-tumour-fraction St Aldric samples into healthy-donor cfDNA ([[low-vaf-in-silico-dilution-results-2025-08]]).
- Finding so far: with fgbio duplex consensus, Mutect2 and VarDictJava both reached about 80% sensitivity at 0.25% VAF on in-silico data, falling to about 35% at 0.05%. Without consensus, false positives per megabase rose about sixfold.
- The question that paused the project: in-silico dilutions do not reproduce real cfDNA error profiles, so their numbers are not trustworthy enough to publish ([[can-in-silico-dilutions-replace-a-physical-truth-set]]).

## Scope and Boundaries

Covers caller choice and thresholds for low-VAF calling. The MRD positivity threshold used in the manuscript is decided in the umbrella study ([[what-vaf-threshold-defines-a-positive-mrd-call]]); this benchmark only informs it.

## Working Context

The published benchmarks we rely on in the meantime are [[maruzani-2024-umi-aware-variant-callers]], [[carrie-2025-benchmarking-ctdna-mutation-calling]] and [[sergi-2024-artificial-low-tumour-fraction-samples]]. Carrié et al., read after the pause, built dilution series from real patient cfDNA, which is closer to what we wanted than our in-silico approach and confirms the decision to wait for the Halo physical truth set rather than publish our in-silico numbers. The archived first spike-in design is [[low-vaf-spike-in-design-v1]].

## Decisions So Far

- Consensus reads built the same way (fgbio duplex) for every caller, so the benchmark compares calling, not consensus ([[fgbio-documentation]]).
- Truth defined by tumour-informed variants in high-tumour-fraction samples, not by caller agreement, to avoid rewarding callers for agreeing with each other.
- No publication of in-silico results alone. Decided at pause, 2025-11-17, by Dmitri and Ines.
- Keep the configurations and container image of the 2025 runs so that the Halo rerun differs only in data.

## Why It Matters Beyond the Benchmark

The MRD call's variant layer uses the in-house error model at a threshold chosen in 2025 ([[what-vaf-threshold-defines-a-positive-mrd-call]]). If the Halo truth set shows that another caller is clearly better below 0.1% VAF, the St Aldric calls would need rerunning, and that would land in the middle of the manuscript revision or after it. For now the risk is accepted: the in-house model matched or beat Mutect2 in-silico, and the revision does not depend on a new caller.

## Resume Checklist

When the contrived-tier key is released: confirm the shortlist is still current (callers updated since 2025?), rebuild consensus with the archived fgbio settings, run all callers on the contrived mutation-dilution samples (0.1% to 2% VAF; deeper resequencing of our spare libraries may be needed below 0.25%), then rerun the 2025 in-silico mixes with the same versions to answer [[can-in-silico-dilutions-replace-a-physical-truth-set]]. Expect about three weeks of Dmitri's time plus Halyard compute.

## Next Actions

- [ ] When the contrived-tier key is released, rerun the shortlist on it with the same configs (stored with the in-silico results).
- [ ] Ask the Halo steering committee whether our spare contrived libraries can be resequenced deeper before unblinding, as the rules forbid re-runs after any key is seen.
- [ ] Until then, nothing; check status at each Halo steering call.
